newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Banco do Brasil stuck over dividends.
newsitem.headline: Banco do Brasil stuck over dividends.

text.p: Brazil's federal bank, Banco do Brasil, is still working out how much it will pay in dividends to shareholders after announcing a first half net profit of 287.7 million reais ($263.9 million), an official said Monday.
Finance director Carlos Gilberto Caetano told reporters that 30.03 percent of the result would be ploughed into dividends, higher than the 25 percent minimum required by Brazilian law.

But the bank was seeking legal advice on how to split up the payments following the recent approval of a new law that entitles holders of non-voting shares to dividends 10 percent higher than those paid to voting shareholders, Caetano said.
The bank wanted to avoid being required to pay the extra 10 percent to all shareholders, he said.
